name: Dropshipper
description: For dropshippers running niche stores and one-product stores: a research team that finds and analyses products, an Ad Creator and a Brand Designer for every product you approve, and a Store Analyst on Shopify and Meta Ads.
forWho: Dropshippers testing products with TikTok and Meta ads
Owners of niche stores and one-product stores on Shopify
Anyone who wants product research, ad content and store numbers in one place

evidence.claim: Products with ads running for several weeks across several advertisers are usually profitable for someone.
evidence.note: Widely used by dropshippers as a demand signal; it also means competition, which the saturation score weighs.

evidence.claim: A 3x-4x markup on landed cost leaves room for paid ads on low-ticket products.
evidence.note: A rule of thumb; your break-even ROAS on each product page is the real test.

evidence.claim: Medical, guaranteed-result and weight-loss claims get ad accounts restricted.
evidence.note: Stated in the ad platforms' policies. The Ad Creator's banned-claims check enforces it.
